title: Semantic Frame v2
description: A structured semantic snapshot of a visible browser viewport. Supports key frames and delta frames for efficient incremental transport. No pixel data is included.

schema.description: Fixed schema identifier. Must be exactly 'semantic-frame-v2'.

sequence.description: Monotonically increasing frame counter, starting at 1 for the first frame sent by a source node.

frameType.description: key frames contain the full visible element set; delta frames only contain changed elements and removedIds.

capturedAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the frame was captured.

captureMs.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds spent on DOM capture and serialisation.

elements.description: For key frames this is the complete visible element set. For delta frames only changed/new elements.

removedIds.description: Element ids that are no longer present in the viewport. Only meaningful for delta frames; should be empty for key frames.

payloadBytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the serialised frame JSON, measured after construction.

checksum.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 checksum of the canonical frame JSON string before the checksum field is added.

width.description: Visible viewport width in CSS pixels.

height.description: Visible viewport height in CSS pixels.

scrollX.description: Horizontal scroll offset in CSS pixels.

scrollY.description: Vertical scroll offset in CSS pixels.

x.description: Left edge of the element relative to the source surface origin, in CSS pixels.

y.description: Top edge of the element relative to the source surface origin, in CSS pixels.

src.description: Resolved media URL at capture time. May be empty if not yet loaded.

duration.description: Total duration in seconds. 0 if unknown or not yet loaded.

paused.description: True if the media is currently paused.

muted.description: True if the media element is muted.

loop.description: True if the media element has the loop attribute set.

id.description: Stable element identity. 'id:<domId>' when the element has a DOM id attribute, otherwise 'el-<n>' where n is a session-scoped counter.

role.description: ARIA-like semantic role. Derived from the role attribute when present, otherwise mapped from the tag name.

text.description: Trimmed visible text content of the element, truncated to 200 characters.

path.description: Human-readable CSS selector path relative to the source surface root. For debugging only.

interactive.description: True if the element accepts user input (button, link, checkbox, textbox, combobox).

disabled.description: True if the element has the disabled attribute or property set.

media.description: Present only for video and audio elements.
